final: WITH sex_averages AS (SELECT p.SEX, AVG(l.CPK * 1.0 / l.GPT) AS sex_avg FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), first_overall AS (SELECT AVG(sex_avg) AS avg1 FROM sex_averages), kept1 AS (SELECT s.SEX, s.sex_avg, s.sex_avg - f.avg1 AS diff1 FROM sex_averages AS s JOIN first_overall AS f ON f.avg1 IS NOT NULL WHERE s.sex_avg > f.avg1), second_overall AS (SELECT AVG(sex_avg) AS avg2 FROM kept1), kept2 AS (SELECT k.sex_avg, k.diff1, k.sex_avg - o.avg2 AS diff2 FROM kept1 AS k JOIN second_overall AS o ON o.avg2 IS NOT NULL WHERE k.sex_avg > o.avg2) SELECT AVG(sex_avg) AS avg_sex_average, AVG(diff1) AS avg_difference_from_first_overall, AVG(diff2) AS avg_difference_from_second_overall FROM kept2
